subject: astronomy
title: Day, Night & Seasons: The Spin
welcome_lead: Earth spins like a top — and that's why we get day and night.
meta_desc: KS3 astronomy: rotation, hours of daylight, sunrise direction.
final_note: Always remember: it's not the Sun moving — it's us.

walkthroughs.body_html: Earth rotates from west to east. From the ground that makes the Sun appear to rise in the east and set in the west each day.
One full rotation takes 24 hours. Sunrise to sunset (daylight) changes through the year because of Earth's tilt.
The Northern Hemisphere (UK, USA) and Southern Hemisphere (Australia) often have opposite weather and seasons.
